name: semantic-crosscheck
description: Cross-layer verification for an ontology plus semantic layer on PostgreSQL 17, for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Prove that a PostgreSQL closure, SHACL rules, OWL reasoning and a Cube model agree.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.8.0: cross-checks PostgreSQL 17 closures, SQL and SHACL rules, OWL/HermiT and Cube against gold SQL. Adds three opt-in synthetic checks: actual compiled original/mutant Cube replay against independent gold SQL, bounded SQL true/false/NULL partition consistency, and independently expected SHACL reports checked by pySHACL and separately installed Apache Jena. Database checks require dedicated synthetic DSNs; Cube replay additionally requires explicit scratch-schema write consent, while TLP is read-only. Input-bound fixtures support replay; missing or malformed engines cannot pass. These auxiliary results do not certify operational data or promote V1-V5 coverage. Existing version 1 configurations and defaults remain supported. Rerun build, reason, cube and verify after upgrading; no shared MVCC snapshot or runtime attestation is claimed.
defaultPrompt: Use semantic-crosscheck to run the synthetic demo end to end.
Use semantic-crosscheck to verify my crosscheck.toml against PostgreSQL and explain what is not proven.
